nodes.label: Dalbit Ninja
nodes.rationale: Project README explicitly describes a LÖVE/GBA-style top-down game architecture.

nodes.label: LÖVE GBA-Style Game
nodes.rationale: Project identity and presentation style are explicit in README and AGENTS.

nodes.label: Global Dependency Loader
nodes.rationale: src/deps.lua loads libraries, modules, assets, and theme into globals.

nodes.label: State Stack Screen Flow
nodes.rationale: StateStack controls start/play/menu layering; top state updates while lower states draw.

nodes.label: Entity State Machines
nodes.rationale: Souls and Husks use StateMachine instances for local behavior.

nodes.label: Vessel Composition
nodes.rationale: Souls and Husks possess Vessel instead of inheriting from it.

nodes.label: Box2D Physics Vessels
nodes.rationale: Vessel encapsulates Box2D physics/collision details for world objects.

nodes.label: Herald Event Bus
nodes.rationale: Herald provides hearken/decree/muster for synchronous events and cleanup.

nodes.label: State-Scoped Input Routing
nodes.rationale: Input routes gameplay actions through state-scoped Herald events.

nodes.label: Realm Map Spawners
nodes.rationale: Realm owns map loading, physics world, and wall/warp/soul/husk spawners.

nodes.label: View and Lens Camera Scaling
nodes.rationale: Lens owns the shared camera and View provides window scale/sizing.

nodes.label: Window-Space Overlays
nodes.rationale: Transition, debug, and menu overlays render in window/screen space.

nodes.label: UI Theme and NineSlice
nodes.rationale: GTheme and NineSlice centralize panel/font/color UI choices.

nodes.label: LuaLS Documentation
nodes.rationale: Project conventions require LuaLS annotations for public API documentation.

nodes.label: Lua Syntax Checks
nodes.rationale: Agents are instructed to run luac -p on changed Lua files.

nodes.label: anim8 MIT License
nodes.rationale: License file explicitly grants MIT-style permissions for the library.

nodes.rationale: License file explicitly grants MIT-style permissions for the library.
